#  44402 - Catalytic Reaction Engineering Modulübersicht  
|  Module Number:   | **44402 - module is no longer offered from WS 2014/15**  |  
| --- | --- |  
| Module Title:  | **Catalytic Reaction Engineering**  |  
|  Auslegung von Gas-Solid Reaktoren   |  
| Department:  |  Faculty 4 - Environmental Sciences and Process Engineering   |  
| Responsible Staff Member:  | 
  * Prof. Dr.-Ing. Schnitzlein, Klaus 

 |  
| Language of Teaching / Examination:  | English  |  
| Duration:  | 1 semester  |  
| Frequency of Offer:  |  Every winter semester   |  
| Credits:  |  
| Learning Outcome:  | Design and operation of gas-solid reactors   |  
| Contents:  | Introduction, Characterization of Porous Solids, Reactions on Solid Surfaces, Mass Transfer, Heat Transfer, Catalytic Reactions, Experimental Determination of Parameters, Noncatalytic Reactions, Fixed Bed Reactors, Fluidized Bed Reactors   |  
| Recommended Prerequisites:  | 
  * Heat and Mass Transfer
  * Fundamentals of Chemical Reac-tion Engineering

 |  
| Mandatory Prerequisites:  | None  |  
| Forms of Teaching and Proportion:  | 
  * Lecture / 2 Hours per Week per Semester 
  * Exercise / 1 Hours per Week per Semester 
  * Practical training / 1 Hours per Week per Semester 
  * Self organised studies / 120 Hours 

 |  
| Teaching Materials and Literature:  | 
  * Smith J.M., Chemical Engineering Kinetics, McGraw Hill 1970
  * Levenspiel, O., Chemical Reaction Engineering, Wiley, 2nd edition 1972.
  * Thomas J.M. and Thomas W.J., Principles and Practice of Heterogeneous Catalysis, VCH Weinheim, 1997
  * Satterfield C.N., Heterogeneous Catalysis in Practice, McGraw Hill 1980
  * Satterfield C.N., Mass Transfer in Heterogeneous Catalysts, MIT Press 1977
  * Bowker M., The Basis and Applications of Heterogeneous Catalysis, Oxford Science Publications 1998
  * Ullmann's Encyclopedia of industrial chemistry, 5th edition, VCH Weinheim 1992
  * Kunii D. and Levenspiel O., Fluidization Engineering, Butterworth-Heinemann 1991
  * Higman C. and van der Burgt M., Gasification, Elsevier Amsterdam 2003

 |  
| Module Examination:  | Unspecified - Specification from winter semester 2016/17 required!  |  
| Assessment Mode for Module Examination:  | 
  * Short tests
  * Lab reports
  * Written examination (120 min) 

 |  
| Evaluation of Module Examination:  | Performance Verification – graded  |  
| Limited Number of Participants:  | None  |  
| Part of the Study Programme:  | 
  * no assignment

 |  
| Remarks:  | **No offer in WS 2013-14!**  |  
| Module Components:  |  
| Components to be offered in the Current Semester:  | 
  * no assignment

 |
